title: design.read is served over MCP next to product_contract.read
description:
SPIDR child 1c of task-8a6d6660c31c4e119f962d13e6f1505d, split from task-06ac0da1ace64032855affc4ab0c1a4e (architect-3c27f2ab, 2026-09-05) when the publish row measured 12 files against the 10-file cap. Cut along the INTERFACE axis: 06ac0da1 publishes the two kinds on the daemon roster + shared contract + generated client; THIS row makes design.read REACHABLE over MCP.

dependsOn task-06ac0da1 — the query kind must exist on RUNTIME_QUERY_KINDS before the port can serve it.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: MCP advertisement + dispatch for design.read, and the behavioural agent-authenticated arms for BOTH kinds (submit is auto-advertised once PAYLOAD_KEYS has it and it is not in MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS; read must be added).

MEASURED: MCP_SERVED_QUERY_KINDS at apps/daemon/src/mcp-tool-allowlist.ts:27-34 is HAND-KEPT. QUERY_HANDLERS at mcp-dispatch-port.ts:297-304 is the SERVED set; servedMcpQueryKinds() reads Object.keys of that table. product_contract.read is the shape to copy (answerProductContractRead at :302). The allowlist test already proves exact set-equality both ways between the two enumerations.

NOT this row: daemon command vocabulary, families, registry, contracts runtime lists, generated client. Those are 06ac0da1.
definitionOfDone: `design.read` is in MCP_SERVED_QUERY_KINDS (mcp-tool-allowlist.ts:27) AND in QUERY_HANDLERS (mcp-dispatch-port.ts:297). The allowlist's existing exact-set-equality test (roster vs servedMcpQueryKinds, both directions) is green. Verify by deleting the entry from each side in turn and confirming both go red.

An agent-authenticated `design.read` over the MCP port RETURNS the design-store answer (latest revision, or DESIGN_REVISION_ABSENT with code AND layer). A query advertised without a handler is an unserved capability.

An agent-authenticated `design.submit` over the MCP port REACHES the handler (the kind is a command, so it is served by NOT being in MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS). Assert it is absent from that exclusion roster and from HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS. Copying the human-only pattern here would make the design step unstaffable.

The handler calls the existing `readDesignRevision` from apps/daemon/src/design/design-store.ts — it does not reimplement the aggregate. Payload is `{goalRef}` plus optional `version`, matching DesignReadInput.
Gates quoted with Test Files N passed: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`.
taskRails: A SERVED QUERY NEEDS BOTH a roster entry and a dispatch handler. One without the other is an advertised capability the port cannot serve.
Call readDesignRevision. Do not reimplement the aggregate. No vocabulary, registry, or generated-client edits — those are task-06ac0da1.
SEAT KINDS, NOT HUMAN GATES. Do not add design.submit or design.read to MCP_EXCLUDED_COMMAND_KINDS or HUMAN_ONLY_STEPS.
